title: Half-Buried Container
wikitext:
A '''Half-Buried Container''' can be found in a ruined home in the mountains to the west of [[Sherwood Quarry]] in [[Northwind]]. Interacting with it while having [[Perfumed Letter (2)|Perfumed Letter #2]] allows for the acquisition of [[Perfumed Letter (3)|Perfumed Letter #3]].
